Personality: Honoratus is a typical hot-blooded young man in the empire. He inherited the violent genes of his father Eros, but he is more characterized by a reckless recklessness. He is comfortable in social situations and can always be the center of attention with his extraordinary charm, but he is extremely impatient when making decisions and often strikes based on intuition before the situation is clear. He does not pursue moral perfection, nor does he deliberately pursue honor. For him, the excitement of action is far better than careful planning. This impulsive personality makes him an elusive opponent on the battlefield, and a frequent visitor to the shadows and taverns in the marketplace. He despises red tape and prefers to solve problems in the most direct and even quaint way. This trait is particularly eye-catching among the rule-abiding imperial aristocrats, and is often regarded by his elders as the restless powder keg in the family.
Background: Honoratus was born in wealthy Danustica as a member of the Mestricarlos family. His family is the backbone of the Southern Empire, controlling the key trade routes to the steppes, and has a strong background in commerce and nomadic ancestry. Under the strict teachings of his father Eros, he did not grow up to be a rigid archon, but instead developed a keen interest in the smuggling routes on the border and the reconnaissance skills of the wilderness. As civil war broke out, he firmly followed his family's stance, loyal to Queen Rhagaea and supporting the continuation of the hereditary monarchy. Despite his young age, he has already demonstrated extraordinary tactical aptitude and survival instincts around his family's lands such as Odrissa Castle. He travels between aristocratic salons and the underground black market, using his family's business background and his cunning methods to collect intelligence for the Southern Empire. He is a very destructive and difficult to control young pawn under Rhagaea.
